text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Muuugh... Why can't I
train, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I only got a tiny, widdle
bit hurt, that's all!!
choice_data_list: No, because I'm worried about you.
Then let's keep giving it our all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehh~!? Trainer, you worry way too much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Mama would definitely let me!
She'd say, "Just a tiny bit, okay?"!
choice_data_list: I'm not your mom, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I know that much!
I was just saying!

After treating the injury, I decided to play it safe
and had her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Nice, Trainer!
That's what I was waiting to hear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Let's get right to it—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Urgh, I told you I'm fine.
More importantly, shouldn't you be getting ready...?"

Unable to just leave it at that, I had Tokai Teio
rest for the day...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, let's head right back then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Today's special, so I'm gonna show you
an even more aaaaa-wesome side of me!"

After finishing the treatment, we resumed training
at Tokai Teio's request.
